title: Ad video 1: mid match, Justin to camera
cover: One advert, twenty seconds, filmed twice with two different openings.
Six cards. One clip per card. Ten minutes.

pieces.title: Mid match, the advert
setup: Phone upright at eye level, window light in front of you, never behind.
Sit where the gaming happens: the sofa. A controller on the arm beside you if there is one.
Your own phone, no tripod polish. The adverts that last look like this.
Say card 1 twice. We keep the better one.

cards.text: They can't stop in the middle of a match.
You say it's time to come off. They go from fine to furious in about four seconds.
So agree it before they start. How many matches. They stop at the end of the last one.
cards.direction: Slower. These are the words they came for.

cards.text: That's one script from Guided Childhood. What stage is your child? Three questions, no sign up.
cards.direction: The last two sentences word for word, every time.

pieces.title: Mid match, the second opening
pieces.platform: Same advert, a different first five seconds
setup: Same seat, same light, straight after V1.
These two cards replace cards 1 and 2. Cards 3 and 4 are reused from V1.
This is the test: which opening makes more parents tap.

cards.text: It's a game. Turn it off now. Most of us have said it.
cards.direction: The first two sentences in the voice you would say them in.

cards.text: And they go from fine to furious, because they can't stop in the middle of a match.
